title: sextant configuration
description: The sextant configuration. One file serves the whole machine: every Claude Code account and configuration directory reads the same file. sextant looks for it at $SEXTANT_CONFIG, then ~/.config/sextant/sextant.json.

preset.description: The preset shipped with the package that "use": "preset" entries draw their rules from. The preset follows the installed package version.

models.description: The models declared active, keyed by full model identifier (for example claude-fable-5-2). A model missing from this map is undeclared.

propertyNames.x-hint: a model key is a full lowercase model identifier with its version, such as claude-fable-5-2, or a wildcard pattern such as claude-opus-4-*

on_undeclared.description: What to do when a model has no entry in "models". There is deliberately no option to block.

scopes.description: Task scopes the user declares, added to the preset's scopes. A scope with the same name as a preset scope replaces only the keys given here. A session takes its scope from SEXTANT_SCOPE; a subagent from the scope whose matcher matches earliest in its task.

propertyNames.x-hint: a scope name is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter

session.description: How a session, as opposed to a subagent, is told apart.

unattended_when_env.description: Environment variables that mark a session as unattended (the place "unattended") when any of them is set and not empty in the environment Claude Code runs in. With none set, a session is in the place "session".

items.x-hint: an environment variable name is letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit

subagents.description: How the subagents a session opens get the rules for the model each one runs on.

delivery.description: prompt: the rules are added at the end of the subagent's task text, before the subagent starts. off: subagents are left alone.

permission.description: The permission decision returned with a call whose task text sextant changed. allow: the call runs without a permission prompt, though deny and ask rules still apply. ask: the person confirms each such call. passthrough: no decision, so the session's permission mode decides, and auto mode can deny a changed call.

on_mismatch.description: What to do when a subagent starts on another model than the one sextant chose its rules for. The decision log records it either way.

modelEntry.description: How a model gets its rules.

use.description: preset: the preset's rules for this exact model. custom: only the rules in "add". none: decided that this model needs no rules.

enable.description: Preset rules, off by default, to turn on.

disable.description: Preset rules, on by default, to turn off.

add.description: The user's own rule files, delivered after the preset's rules.

then.x-hint: a model declared with "use": "none" takes no other key
a model declared with "use": "custom" takes only "add", with at least one rule

wildcardEntry.description: A wildcard key only declares models that need no rules. Rules always need the exact model identifier, so a new model version never inherits rules written for an earlier one.

use.x-hint: a wildcard key only accepts {"use": "none"}; give rules under the exact model identifier

wildcardEntry.x-hint: a wildcard key only accepts {"use": "none"}; give rules under the exact model identifier

file.description: Path to the rule text, relative to this configuration file or absolute.

scopes.description: Scopes the rule applies to, or ["*"] for every scope.

description.description: What kind of task this scope covers.

match.description: Regular expressions (JavaScript syntax, case-insensitive, Unicode-aware) matched against a subagent's description and task text. The scope whose matcher matches earliest wins; at the same place, the scope declared first.

ruleId.x-hint: a rule id is lowercase segments separated by "/", such as team/commit-style

place.description: session: a session someone is watching. unattended: a session nobody is watching. subagent: a subagent's task.
